_doc: Places Pearl has that this game does not build yet (b2tools/pearl_story.py CLOSED: schema there). Keyed by Pearl map name. A row is a step trigger {x, z, w, h, dir, text}: walking onto it shows text in the plain window, then the player steps once in dir (Pearl's 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right); or {talk: true, obj: <Pearl object id> | bg: <Pearl bg event index>, text}: that person or sign shows text instead of its script. Text: plain words, \n breaks the line (Black 2's window is 224 px wide). A talk row with "musical": true is a Pokémon Musical receptionist instead (src/include/pearl_musical.inc): its text is the greeting, in Pearl spelling (\n, \r a new page), then Black 2's Musical (data/pearl_musical.json).
